newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb on dollar demand.

text.p: The Pakistan rupee dropped 0.30 rupee to end at 41.45 rupees to the dollar on Friday on strong demand for the U.S. currency fuelled by fears of a further devaluation of the rupee, dealers said.
"The recent downward adjustment of the rupee against the dollar has prompted fears for another rupee devaluation ahead of the 1997/98 (July-June) budget," a dealer said.

The State Bank (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, changed on April 23, was 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed up at 3.0 percent from 2.30 in the previous day. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
